create.name: Sommer Leigh
create.bio:
Sommer Leigh runs Sound Science Soul, a meditation and sound project she started in Des Moines, Iowa. Before turning to meditation she spent more than a decade in the music business as a promoter, journalist and podcast host, and her own search for steadiness led her into metaphysics and into study with Buddhist and mindfulness teachers and with sound healers. Her approach sits where contemplative practice meets brainwave research, and she treats the two as complementary rather than opposed.

Her recordings use isochronic tones, binaural and 8D audio, mantra chanting and non-sleep deep rest to guide listeners into alpha, theta and delta states for rest, visualisation and inner exploration. On YouTube she also publishes short reflective talks on consciousness, archetypes and how habits of perception shape experience. She sells individual meditations as downloads, offers multi-day brainwave courses on Insight Timer, has supplied tracks to the Flowtime biofeedback headband app, and has recently built Unscripted, an app with brief daily exercises for noticing and changing habitual reactions as they arise.

courses.title: Theta Transcendence
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course that uses theta-range brainwave audio alongside guided journeys into the subconscious. It is framed as a gradual opening towards a felt sense of spiritual connection.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Delta Deep: Exploring The Depths Of Sleep And Mystical Experiences
courses.description: A four-day Insight Timer course on the slowest brainwave band, pairing delta audio with teaching on deep sleep as a practice. It also looks at the dreamlike and mystical states that can arise there.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: "The 369" Alpha Deep Meditative Journey with 8D Audio
courses.description: A downloadable meditation combining 8D audio with alpha-range isochronic tones, intended for relaxed focus and inner exploration. Her beta listeners rated it the favourite of her alpha recordings.

courses.title: Primordial Sound Meditation | Mantra Chanting
courses.description: A recorded mantra chant traditionally used at sunrise, which can be played alone or under another sitting practice. Theta and alpha versions with isochronic tones are sold separately.

courses.title: Unscripted
courses.description: An app she created that builds a personal plan from a short quiz, then offers brief daily practices for spotting a habitual reaction as it starts and choosing a different response.

free_resources.title: Sommer Leigh on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Brainwave entrainment tracks, non-sleep deep rest sessions, mantra chanting and guided visualisations under the Sound Science Soul name. The single tracks are free to hear.

flags: She works under the brand Sound Science Soul and reads more as a sound/brainwave content creator and app founder than a traditional teacher; a human may want to check the fit.
Email soundsciencesoul@gmail.com is the brand inbox published on the contact page.

Only one photo used (IMG_8647 on her site, the same image captioned 'Sommer Leigh' in the Flowtime partnership announcement); she wears a Flowtime headband in it. A Teachable founder photo (file named Sharon-Sommer) looks quite different (darker hair, younger) and was not used; identity across the two not confirmed.
Much of her YouTube and Insight Timer catalogue is titled for anxiety, overthinking, rumination or sleep problems; all of those were left out, which is why the video list leans on her short talks.
Her contact page offers meditation coaching 'specializing in trauma recovery' and sound 'for Health & Healing'; not included.
Download prices come from Payhip product pages (shown with $ only, USD assumed); the Unscripted app shows no price before the quiz.
Video view counts could not be read from the channel page, so videos were picked by title from the latest 30 uploads.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on her own site and Teachable pages.
